【原视频简介】
Master the rich, comforting flavors of the Mediterranean with an easy casserole, essential feta cheese shopping rules, and a silky braised vegetable side dish. Bridget Lancaster makes a traditional Greek pastitsio, and shares a time-saving hack: parcooking pasta in a béchamel sauce. Jack Bishop shares what you need to know about buying feta cheese and why you should avoid pre-crumbled feta. Julia Collin Davison shares the three essential types of kitchen towels to streamline your kitchen cleanup. Finally, Lan Lam makes a hearty dish of braised eggplant with paprika and yogurt, with advice on which types of eggplant are best to use, and tips on the best way to braise and glaze them for a perfectly savory bite.
